告诉用户发生了什么：StatusBadge 标出记录状态，EmptyState: Tell users what is going on: StatusBadge marks a record's status, EmptyState says why a view is empty and what to do next, ConfirmAction asks before a dangerous action, toast reports the result of an action, and Skeleton holds the place of content that is loading. Don't use alert / window.confirm. toast translates string messages itself, but not options such as description or the texts of toast.promise: wrap those in t().
六种语义色，每种有浅色底、带圆点和 plain 三种样式；文字写中文原文，由组件: Six semantic tones, each as a tinted pill, with a dot, and plain; write the Chinese source text and the component translates it.
用 Record<Status, { label, tone }> 把接口的状态: Map the API's status values to text and tone with Record<Status, { label, tone }>, so a missing status fails to compile; secondary yes / no states use plain.
默认样式；还没有数据时说明原因并给出下一步；搜索无结果时提供清除搜索。: The default; when there is no data yet, say why and offer the next step; when a search finds nothing, offer to clear it.
onConfirm 返回 Promise 时确认按钮显示加载；失败时先 toas: When onConfirm returns a Promise the confirm button shows a spinner; on failure, call toast.apiError and rethrow so the dialog stays open; set destructive={false} for actions that aren't dangerous.
四种类型加普通消息；带变量的文字先用 t()；apiError 优先显示接口返回: Four types plus a plain message; build text with variables with t() first; apiError shows the API's error first; toast.promise follows the result of an async operation.
加载时按真实内容的形状放 Skeleton，数据到了原位替换；Skeleton: While loading, place Skeletons in the shape of the real content and swap them in place when the data arrives; a Skeleton fades in only after 200ms, so fast requests don't flash.
文件夹不为空，无法删除: The folder isn't empty and can't be deleted
文件夹里的文件会一起删除。: The files in the folder are deleted with it.
发布后所有用户都会收到通知。: Every user is notified once it is published.
创建第一个项目，再邀请成员一起协作。: Create your first project, then invite members to work on it together.
库存不足，请调整数量: Not enough stock; adjust the quantity
新版本已发布，刷新后生效: A new version is out; refresh to use it
语义色：草稿 / 停用用 neutral，进行中 info，成功 success: Semantic tone: neutral for drafts / disabled, info for in progress, success for succeeded, warning for pending, danger for failed
文字前加圆点（plain 样式总是带圆点）: Adds a dot before the text (plain always has one)
soft：浅色底的标签；plain：只有圆点和灰色文字: soft: a tinted pill; plain: just a dot and muted text
文字（中文原文，组件内翻译）: Text (Chinese source text, translated by the component)
标题（中文原文，组件内翻译）: Title (Chinese source text, translated by the component)
说明为什么是空的、下一步做什么（中文原文，组件内翻译）: Why it is empty and what to do next (Chinese source text, translated by the component)
追加的 class，例如调整上下留白: Extra classes, e.g. to change the vertical padding
触发按钮（单个元素，本身不要再写 onClick）: The trigger (a single element; don't give it its own onClick)
确认框标题（中文原文，组件内翻译）: Dialog title (Chinese source text, translated by the component)
后果说明，例如「删除后不可恢复。」: What happens, e.g. "This can't be undone."
红色确认按钮；不危险的操作设为 false: Red confirm button; set to false for actions that aren't dangerous
确认后调用；返回 Promise 时按钮显示加载，失败（reject）时确认框保: Called on confirm; with a Promise the button shows a spinner, and the dialog stays open if it rejects
只渲染触发按钮，不弹确认框: Renders only the trigger, without the confirmation
字符串消息自动翻译；带变量的文字先用 t() 拼好: String messages are translated; build text with variables with t() first
没有图标的普通消息: A plain message without an icon
显示接口返回的 { error }，没有时显示兜底文案: Shows the API's { error }, or the fallback when there is none
sonner 原样透出：文字不会自动翻译，需要自己用 t(): Passed through from sonner as is: texts are not translated, use t() yourself
取出接口错误文字（已翻译），用于页面内显示错误: The API's error text (translated), for showing errors in the page
sonner 选项（description、duration、action 等）: sonner options (description, duration, action, …); not translated
尺寸和形状，照着真实内容写，例如 h-4 w-32、size-9 rounded: Size and shape, following the real content, e.g. h-4 w-32 or size-9 rounded-full
